description: This is a test class for the ConceptDrugValidator in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for validation logic on Drug objects.

classes.name: ConceptDrugValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ConceptDrugValidator methods, including validation and support checks on Drug objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAConceptIsNotSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the validator correctly reports errors when the Drug object does not have a concept specified.

methods.name: supports_shouldRejectClassesNotExtendingDrug
methods.description: Tests that the validator's supports method returns false for classes that are not subclasses of Drug.

methods.name: supports_shouldSupportDrug
methods.description: Tests that the validator's supports method returns true for the Drug class.
